definitions: A device, typically a scoop or a net, used for gathering oysters, other shellfish, or objects from the bottom of the sea or a river.
A machine or boat fitted with a dredge, used for clearing out the bed of a harbour or river, or for recovering material from the seabed.
A mixture of flour and seasonings into which food is dipped before cooking.
examples: He prepared the dredge for the chicken.
